scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/lib/cloudflare-env.test.ts src/lib/http/app-error.test.ts src/lib/ingest/keys.test.ts src/lib/media/parse-portfolio-media-path.test.ts src/lib/media/parse-review-media-path.test.ts src/lib/portfolio/hero-photos.test.ts src/lib/review/collection-access.test.ts src/lib/trpc/errors.test.ts
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.r2:cors:apply: wrangler r2 bucket cors set photography-portfolio --file infra/r2-cors/photography-portfolio.json -y && wrangler r2 bucket cors set photography-review --file infra/r2-cors/photography-review.json -y
scripts.r2:cors:list: wrangler r2 bucket cors list photography-portfolio && wrangler r2 bucket cors list photography-review
